run_preprocess_TR2016: run the script to convert TR2016 mention data into KILT JSONL format for train and test splits
convert_TR2016_to_KILT: convert TR2016 dataset mentions and documents into KILT JSONL format with Wikidata entity IDs
load_wikidata_mappings: load pickle files containing language title to Wikidata ID, redirect, and label mappings
resolve_wikidata_ids: resolve entity titles to Wikidata IDs using get_wikidata_ids with title, redirect, and alias lookup tables
extract_hard_mentions: extract and save only the hard mentions from the TR2016 dataset into a separate JSONL file
